text:
For most local businesses, the Google Business Profile is the real homepage.

Think about how people actually find a clinic, a salon or a CA: they search, look at the map, read two reviews, check the hours, and call. Many never open the website.

So the profile has to answer what a homepage would:
→ What exactly you do (the right primary category)
→ When you're open, including holiday hours
→ What it looks like inside (real photos, updated monthly)
→ What other customers say (and that you reply to them)
→ How to reach you in one tap (call, WhatsApp, booking link)

It's free, it takes an afternoon, and it's the first impression most of your customers get.

When did you last update yours?
